title: Software Engineer, Professional Services R&D
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**About the Team**
------------------



The Professional Services R\&D team is a new, dynamic group at the forefront of innovation within Okta. Our mission is to design and build reusable, scalable assets and tools that empower our delivery teams and partners. By making customer engagements more efficient, streamlined, and cost\-effective, we directly contribute to our customers' success and accelerate their time\-to\-value with Okta. This is a unique opportunity to join a strategic team from the ground up and shape the future of Okta's professional services.


**Position Summary**
--------------------



As a Software Engineer on the R\&D team, you will be a key player in developing the next generation of professional services assets. You will have the opportunity to work with a wide array of technologies, including Java, React, Node, Python, and .NET, to create solutions that will be leveraged by thousands of customers globally. We are looking for a creative and passionate engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and is excited about building tools that have a massive impact.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design, develop, test, and deploy high\-quality, reusable software assets and tools.
* Collaborate with technical architects, delivery consultants, and product managers to identify opportunities for innovation and define project requirements.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code across a variety of technology stacks.
* Create proofs\-of\-concept and prototypes to explore new ideas and technologies.
* Engage with the field and our partners to gather feedback and ensure the solutions you build are effective and easy to use.
* Contribute to the team's engineering best practices and act as a mentor to other team members.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of professional software development experience.
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Node.js, or C\# (.NET).
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as React.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.
* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts is highly desirable but not required.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and a passion for building high\-quality software.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

description:

**Job Summary**

The Senior Staff Software Engineer provides strategic leadership focused on driving the architecture, design, and delivery of advanced financial technology systems. This position requires deep technical mastery, mentorship of engineers and collaboration across senior leadership. Engineers in this role lead innovation, optimize processes, and ensure solutions align with business objectives and enterprise standards and architect and lead full stack development across the SDLC, enhancing frontend, backend, and UI/UX components

* Drive the design, development, and delivery of advanced financial technology solutions. Translate complex business needs into technical designs and oversee their implementation. Lead architectural decisions to ensure scalability, security, and performance. Take ownership of the most critical systems and resolve high\-impact issues efficiently. \- (15%)
* Lead the definition and enforcement of coding standards, testing protocols, and automation strategies across teams. Analyze and resolve defects, performance bottlenecks, and systemic inefficiencies. Advocate for best practices in software engineering and Agile development while driving enterprise\-wide initiatives. \- (15%)

Experience with Agentic AI, RAG, Gen AI

Python

At Bread Financial, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community, and be part of our award\-winning culture. title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**Data \& Integrations Team \| Navan**



Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader building the backbone of our corporate travel infrastructure. You will architect and develop the critical systems that allow the world's largest companies to configure, manage, and scale their travel programs—covering everything from complex policy engines and approval workflows to user lifecycle management and enterprise analytics.



This is a high\-impact engineering role where you will solve complex logic and scalability challenges. You will ensure that our platform can handle sophisticated corporate rules and seamless integrations for massive global organizations. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and architects to design and build innovative solutions that empower our customers to manage their travel spend effectively.


**What You'll Do**


* **Architect Enterprise Core Services:** Design, build, and evolve the backend microservices that power the "brain" of the corporate travel platform—specifically the engines responsible for travel policies, dynamic approval workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* **Build Data\-Driven Services:** Design and develop highly scalable APIs and data processing services that manage high volumes of data, power reporting features, and enable seamless integrations with both internal and external systems.
* **Own Systems End\-to\-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain, architecting, developing, and launching key backend features and microservices that have a direct impact on our users and business operations.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work cross\-functionally with various engineering, product, and business teams to deliver complex, cross\-domain features in a collaborative, global environment.
* **Drive the Technical Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the long\-term technical roadmap for our data platform. Be a subject matter expert on backend architecture, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high\-quality, scalable, and well\-tested code. Mentor other engineers on backend development and advocate for best practices in system design, API development, monitoring, and operational reliability.


**What We're Looking For**


* 4\+ years of experience in backend software development, building large\-scale distributed systems for SaaS products or consumer\-facing applications in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, with a strong grasp of JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and concurrency.
* Proven experience with databases (**SQL and/or NoSQL**), complex data modeling, and query optimization to handle large datasets.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, resilient applications using **microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures** on cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred).
* Demonstrates strong technical ownership and a collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a proven ability to ship production\-quality services equipped with robust testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* A passion for investigating and solving challenging problems in system scalability and data integrity, with a willingness to learn and utilize new tools and technologies.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience.


**Bonus Points For**


* Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly in building backend systems to support agentic AI, LLM\-based features, or autonomous workflows.
* Deep familiarity with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis), ETL processes, and reporting systems.
* Experience with performance and scalability testing for high\-throughput services.
* Familiarity with travel industry concepts (e.g., bookings, inventory, integrations with GDS or other suppliers).

  


Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers.


**Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.


* **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Meet The Team
  
  

The Cisco Intersight team is at the forefront of Cisco’s AI Infrastructure strategy, serving as the intelligent management platform that orchestrates and simplifies complex hybrid cloud environments. We provide the control plane that enables organizations to deploy, monitor, and optimize AI\-driven workloads across distributed infrastructure, playing a critical role in the broader Cisco AI story. Our team is a high\-performing, collaborative group of engineers who thrive on solving complex distributed systems challenges in a fast\-paced environment. We pride ourselves on a culture of technical excellence and innovation, where every team member is empowered to influence the future of cloud management. What makes us truly exciting is our mission to build the"brai" of the modern data center, enabling seamless AI operations at scale.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

A successful candidate will have deep technical and software expertise in cloud\-native technologies and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, startup\-like environment to deliver seamless, scalable solutions with broad business impact.
  
  

We seek individuals driven by the challenge of solving unique technical problems, who thrive with creative freedom, and are eager to explore new territories and learn. You care about your work and its impact.
  
  

You will develop and validate infrastructure, software components, and integrations in on\-prem and cloud environments. You should have a good sense of product design, passion for quality and customers, and willingness to work in small, self\-organizing teams are essential. If you want to excel in a fast\-paced environment creating and shaping the future of AI infrastructure, this job is for you!
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's in Computer Science (or equivalent) with 5 years or Master's with 3 years or PhD with 0 year of related experience.
* Experience programming with Go, C/C\+\+, Java and/or Python
* Experience with microservices software architecture and large\-scale distributed systems
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Experience working with cloud technologies like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud
* Good understanding of Linux, OS and networking fundamentals.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Software and product development experience with cloud computing and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience withcontainerizationand orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with virtualization environments such as vSphere, HyperV, KVM.
* Deep understanding of AI technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to effectively leverage them to improve engineering productivity, solution design, and problem\-solving.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
